_note: IG-independent physical reference sets: the sensors located at / directly downstream of the physical origin of each fault. TEP sets are derived from the flowsheet location of each disturbance as defined by Downs & Vogel (1993) and the TEP variable list; CWRU from the test-rig geometry (faults seeded in the drive-end bearing; DE accelerometer mounted closest to it). Variable lists were compiled for this revision and MUST be confirmed by a process/vibration expert before publication.

1.fault: A/C feed ratio, B composition constant (step), stream 4
1.rationale: A feed (stream 1) and A+C feed (stream 4) flows and their valves compensate the ratio change

2.fault: B composition, A/C ratio constant (step), stream 4
2.rationale: inert B accumulates; purge rate, purge valve and B in purge respond

4.rationale: reactor temperature, reactor cooling-water outlet temperature and cooling-water flow valve

6.rationale: A feed flow drops, A feed valve saturates, reactor pressure rises

10.rationale: stream 4 enters the stripper: stripper temperature, steam flow and steam valve

12.fault: Condenser cooling water inlet temperature (random variation)
12.rationale: separator temperature, separator cooling-water outlet temperature, condenser cooling-water flow

13.rationale: reactor pressure and temperature drift with the reactor cooling loop

14.rationale: sticking valve, reactor temperature and cooling-water outlet temperature

fault_classes.rationale: all seeded faults (inner race, ball, outer race) are in the drive-end bearing; DE is the accelerometer closest to it

normal_class.rationale: no fault origin; excluded from physical-correctness metrics (also: BA channel zero-filled in the Normal record)
